LanguageData.TM_MasterTomePriest.label: master tome: priest
LanguageData.TM_MasterTomePriest.description: A rare tome for a priest who has met the requirements for mastery. Reading it completes the corresponding initiation and consumes the tome. Available from traders and quest rewards; it cannot be crafted.
